title: ChebBooster: A Training-Free Approach for Efficient Diffusion Transformer Inference via Chebyshev-Inspired Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23429v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have shown strong performance in high-fidelity image generation, but their sampling process remains computationally intensive due to full model execution at every timestep. While cache-based acceleration has been explored to mitigate inference cost, naive reuse schemes suffer from low accuracy over long intervals, and Taylor-series-based extrapolation methods often face instability caused by Runge oscillations. In this paper, we propose ChebBooster, a training-free extrapolation framework based on Chebyshev polynomial theory that achieves stable and efficient acceleration for DiTs. Specifically, we adopt the Barycentric formulation to evaluate Chebyshev approximants with high numerical stability and minimal overhead, and further decouple the extrapolation into an offline weight precomputation phase and a lightweight online application stage. translated_title: ChebBooster：一种基于切比雪夫外推的无训练高效扩散Transformer推理方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23429v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：扩散Transformer（DiTs）在高保真图像生成中表现出色，但其采样过程由于每个时间步都需要完整执行模型而计算量巨大。虽然基于缓存的加速方法已被探索以降低推理成本，但简单的重用方案在长时间间隔内精度较低，而基于泰勒级数的外推方法常因龙格振荡而面临不稳定性问题。在本文中，我们提出ChebBooster，一种基于切比雪夫多项式理论的无训练外推框架，可为DiTs实现稳定且高效的加速。具体而言，我们采用重心公式来评估切比雪夫近似，具有高数值稳定性和最小开销，并进一步将外推过程解耦为离线权重预计算阶段和轻量级在线应用阶段。在三个具有代表性的基于DiT的模型上进行了大量实验。
tldr: 本文提出ChebBooster，一种利用切比雪夫多项式理论和重心公式的无训练外推方法，通过离线预计算与在线轻量应用解耦，解决了扩散Transformer推理中缓存重用精度低和泰勒外推不稳定的问题，实现了稳定高效的加速。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ChebBooster, a training-free extrapolation framework leveraging Chebyshev polynomial theory and barycentric formulation, which decouples offline weight precomputation from lightweight online application to address low accuracy in cache reuse and instability in Taylor extrapolation, achieving stable and efficient acceleration for Diffusion Transformers.
